data.one_liner: Sqflite web implementation using sqlite3 ffi and sqlite3 wasm.
data.what_it_does: Provides a web implementation for sqflite using sqlite3 ffi and sqlite3 wasm. Enables persisting data in IndexedDB and running database operations in a shared worker.
use_when: You need to use sqflite in Flutter web applications
You want persistent SQL storage in the browser using IndexedDB
avoid_when: You need multiple connections to the same database file (singleInstance: false is not supported)
You want a fully stable, non-experimental web database solution
weaknesses: Single connection per database limit (no singleInstance: false)
data.setup_notes: Requires adding sqlite3.wasm binaries and a sqflite specific shared worker to your web folder using the setup command 'dart run sqflite_common_ffi_web:setup'.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: A reactive SQLite database for Dart and Flutter with robust multi-platform support including web.
